findingDetails.title: First-map prose anchor can silently skip a half-removed map section
findingDetails.case: ROUTER.md where a map heading is removed but part of its body survives before the next MAP heading; start re-anchors at the next matching heading, so a backticked webflow/...md claim left in the orphaned body is never required to be routed; the old exact-literal anchor returned -1 and the leg reported section anchors not found
findingDetails.evidence: proseExplicitPaths start is md.search of the first map heading (line 129); the leg 1a test builds only a fully replaced section (test line 165); the doc-claims bases() has no arm for a webflow/-prefixed backticked ref and RETIRED_NAMES match only code-webflow word forms, so no other guard reads the skipped span
findingDetails.userImpact: a half-cleaned ROUTER.md can keep citing webflow paths that no longer exist while the guard reports PASS; a missed documentation lint, not a runtime failure
findingDetails.scopeProof: proseExplicitPaths is the only consumer of start; the only other anchor is the unchanged end; no fixture keeps a removed heading with its body
findingDetails.recommendation: scan from the heading before the first surviving map heading, or assert the span before it holds no path-shaped prose; add a body-kept fixture to the leg 1a test
findingDetails.confidence: high on the mechanics, medium that the half-removed state occurs
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a test or the documented removal script proving a map heading is never deleted without its body
